title: Shubman Gill joins Temple wearable users: What Deepinder Goyal's  ₹85,000 device can track
snippet: Shubman Gill tested Zomato founder Deepinder Goyal’s unreleased Temple AI fitness tracking device during India’s practice session in Auckland on 29 October. The forehead-mounted wearable is designed to track cerebral blood flow, nervous system responses and cognitive stress during physical activity.

title: Amazon Prime Video on track to generate tens of billions in revenue, Andy Jassy confirms

title: Karbonn Rebel 5G teased on Amazon: How the Indian brand eyes comeback with affordable smartphones for Gen Z
snippet: Karbonn is making a comeback in India’s smartphone market, targeting Gen Z and content creators with affordable devices amid rising smartphone prices. The homegrown brand has teased the Rebel 5G on Amazon, but its specifications, pricing and launch date remain unconfirmed.

title: AI-led services to generate up to USD 200 billion in new work by 2030: BCG report
snippet: Artificial intelligence (AI)-led services are expected to generate between USD 100 billion and USD 200 billion in net new work by 2030, with technology services companies able to meet most of the demand by reskilling their existing employees, according to a report by Boston Consulting Group (BCG).
